seo.title: Jai Rajveer Singh Shekhawat — Entrepreneur & Founder, AIT World Automation
seo.description: Jai Rajveer Singh Shekhawat is an Indian technology professional, entrepreneur and business leader working across IT, home automation, IoT, smart technology, industrial automation and digital transformation.

hero.name: Jai Rajveer Singh Shekhawat
hero.role: Technology Entrepreneur — Founder, AIT World Automation · Home Automation · IoT · Industrial Automation · Digital Transformation
hero.lede: Building connected technology since 2010 — from IT infrastructure at Hewlett-Packard to founding AIT Service Corporation in 2012 and growing it into AIT World Automation Pvt. Ltd., a home and industrial automation company recognised as the Best Home Automation Company in India.

paragraphs: Jai Rajveer Singh Shekhawat, professionally known as Jai Rajveer Singh, is an Indian technology professional, entrepreneur and business leader associated with the information technology, home automation, smart technology, IoT and digital transformation sectors.

He pursued his engineering education at the University College of Engineering and Technology, Bikaner, which gave him the technical foundation for his later work in information technology, business development and automation.

In 2012 he founded AIT Service Corporation, initially focused on IT sales, technical support and related technology services. The business later expanded into IoT, home automation, smart technology and industrial automation, and evolved into AIT World Automation Pvt. Ltd.
He is also the founder of ReportNow, a Verified Risk Intelligence Platform developed by AIT World Automation Pvt. Ltd., which is currently under development.
